title: Well-formedness of the embedded machine
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes. Regard it as an oracle Turing machine with state set formed by adjoining three fresh states, designated as the query state and the positive- and negative-answer states. The resulting oracle machine is well formed: its query state and two answer states are pairwise distinct.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes
replaced:
For every plain multi-tape machine with $k$ work tapes, the oracle machine
obtained by embedding it into the oracle model is well formed: its three fresh
special states (query, positive answer, negative answer) are pairwise
distinct.
